title: [tenmin-history] addCalendarYears: characterization test for forward and zero calendar year shifts
body:
Target: PeaceG03/PeaceSTOCKS

add a characterization test for addCalendarYears in src/tenmin-history.ts: calendar years
- addCalendarYears("2024-02-29", 4) is "2028-02-29"
- addCalendarYears("2023-03-31", 1) is "2024-03-31"
- addCalendarYears("2025-02-28", -1) is "2024-02-28"
- addCalendarYears("2026-10-13", 0) is "2026-10-13"
- addCalendarYears("2026-1-05", 1) throws INVALID_SESSION_DATE

(Builder pre-file, TEST_CASE_EXISTING, public-test-case-existing-v1): Peace's task (source: peace). Year shifts are tested backwards (-2) and Feb 29 to a non-leap year only; Feb 29 to a leap year, a forward shift, a zero shift, Feb 28 back into a leap year and the INVALID_SESSION_DATE guard are untested; this pins them. Production safety: test-only: one new src/*.test.ts file only: no source edits, no fix commit. Job B grades it fix-free: the test passes on the current code and fails with the function body stubbed. The running scanner chain is unchanged. A box dry-run on PeaceSTOCKS 663e31e (Workspace main 129a084, live 26-rule approved list, Node 22) built exactly one candidate (public-test-case-existing-v1); a local Job B run graded it COUNTS (the new test passes on the current code and fails with addCalendarYears stubbed); suite 585/585 with all eleven new tests of this batch, all 4 typechecks ok. Disjoint file: each task in this batch creates its own new test file. Expected COUNTS.)
